title: Theater of Wishes
description: A wizard in green velvet sleeves and white gloves stands at a purple velvet counter, pointing at an open spellbook. Behind him is an ornate arched alcove labeled 'Theater of Wishes' filled with glowing potion bottles on shelves, each labeled with magical audience and crowd effects.
prompt: A detailed fantasy illustration of a wizard's hand in white gloves pointing at an open glowing spellbook on a purple velvet counter. Behind is an ornate arched theater-like alcove with red and gold striped dome labeled 'Theater of Wishes', filled with shelves of glowing blue, green and purple potion bottles labeled Audience Applause, Crowd Reaction, and Enchanted Cheers. Hanging glass lantern with potions above, mystical smoke, rich jewel tones, theatrical atmosphere.
